_note: FY2024 Amtrak service between RailPlanner's cities, used to calibrate the demand model (scripts/calibrate_demand.py). Station ridership is boardings plus alightings from Amtrak's FY2024 state fact sheets. Services list the stops among RailPlanner's 17 cities only, minutes from the first stop, and typical daily round trips. Hub stations (New York, Philadelphia, Chicago) are excluded from the fit because most of their riders use other services.
